question: 'Amongmong Festival' is associated with which of the following states/UTs?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nagaland**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Mongmong Festival is associated with the state of Nagaland, India: 
 
• The Mongmong Festival is a harvest festival celebrated by the Sangtam people of Nagaland.
 
• It is held annually from September 1–6. 
 
• The word "Mongmong" means "Togetherness Forever". 
 
• Significance
 
• The festival symbolizes hard work, unity, and prayers for a bountiful harvest. 
 
• The village priest, called "Beburu", gives the signal to start the festival with prayers and rites.
